grammarFocus: we / they；are；规则复数；my / your / his / her；have / has。
title: My Family and Their Things
instructions: 听录音，完成8个问题。录音会播放两遍。问题类型包括单选题和填空题。填空题答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过规定字数。所有题目均基于录音内容，不要求推理。
transcript: A: Hi, this is my family photo. We are in the living room. B: Wow, nice. Who are they? A: This is my mother. She has two sisters. And this is my father. He has one brother. B: So you have two aunts and one uncle? A: Yes. My uncle has three children. My aunt has one son. B: Are they your cousins? A: Yes, they are. We have four cousins. B: And your grandparents? A: They are not in the photo. They are at home. B: I see. Your family is big. A: Yes, we are a big family. We are happy.

questions.prompt: 录音中，说话者A的家人在哪里？
questions.explanation: 录音开头A说“We are in the living room.”，意思是“我们在客厅”。因此选“在客厅”。
questions.evidence: We are in the living room.

questions.prompt: 根据录音，A的母亲有几个姐妹？
questions.explanation: A说“She has two sisters.”，意思是“她有两个姐妹”。所以选“两个”。

questions.prompt: 根据录音，A的父亲有几个兄弟？
questions.explanation: A说“He has one brother.”，意思是“他有一个兄弟”。所以选“一个”。

questions.prompt: 根据录音，A的叔叔有几个孩子？
questions.explanation: A说“My uncle has three children.”，意思是“我叔叔有三个孩子”。所以选“三个”。

questions.prompt: 根据录音，A的阿姨有几个儿子？
questions.explanation: A说“My aunt has one son.”，意思是“我阿姨有一个儿子”。所以选“一个”。

questions.prompt: 根据录音，A一共有几个表兄弟姐妹（cousins）？请用英文数字填空。
questions.explanation: A说“We have four cousins.”，意思是“我们有四个表兄弟姐妹”。所以填“four”。

questions.prompt: 根据录音，A的祖父母在哪里？
questions.explanation: A说“They are at home.”，意思是“他们在家”。所以选“在家”。

questions.prompt: 根据录音，A怎样描述他们的家庭？
questions.explanation: A说“We are a big family.”，意思是“我们是一个大家庭”。所以选“一个大家庭”。注意：录音也说了“We are happy.”，但问题问的是“怎样描述家庭”，直接对应的是“big family”。

vocabulary.example: We are in the living room.
They are not in the photo.

grammar.title: we / they；are；规则复数；my / your / his / her；have / has
grammar.explanation: 英语中，'we' 表示“我们”，'they' 表示“他们”。动词 'are' 与 we/they 连用。名词复数一般加 -s，如 sisters。'my' 表示“我的”，'your' 表示“你的”，'his' 表示“他的”，'her' 表示“她的”。动词 'have' 用于 I/you/we/they，'has' 用于 he/she/it。
grammar.example: We are a big family. She has two sisters.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：They ___ my parents.
选择正确的单词填空：She ___ a brother.
选择正确的单词填空：This is my sister. ___ name is Anna.
选择正确的单词填空：We ___ four cousins.
